stories.headline: Wildfire in Rensselaer County Spreads to Western Massachusetts
stories.dek: Wildfire in Rensselaer County spreads to Western Massachusetts
stories.body: Crews are battling a wildfire in Rensselaer County that has spread into Western Massachusetts, according to WAMC Northeast Public Radio. The fire started in the Town of Berlin and covered roughly 50 acres as of Monday afternoon. Authorities are slated to give an update on the blaze, WTEN News10 reported. The fire is currently in Rensselaer County, Western Massachusetts, and the Capital Region. The fire is 70% contained, WTEN News10 reported, while WAMC Northeast Public Radio reported it covered 50 acres as of Monday afternoon.
